Japan's **Anthropic Usage Index is 1.91** (period 2026-05-01). It ranks **32nd out of 121** countries.

The index is a country's share of Claude usage divided by its share of the working-age population. A value of 1.0 is the global average, so Japan's Claude usage is about 91% higher than its population alone would predict.

Some context against the global average:
- **Work, personal and coursework:** 47% / 47% / 6% in Japan, compared with 43% / 40% / 16% globally.
- **Augmentation vs. automation:** 53% / 47% in Japan, compared with 51% / 49% globally.

Source and methodology: https://www.anthropic.com/economic-index
